methodology.randomization: One random.Random(seed); shuffle colours first; sample each region x then y, rejecting invalid separation/corridors. x from nominal row to 85% of remaining far bound; y within lane +/-0.030 m.
methodology.world: coco_world; canonical robot start, ramp, no additional obstacles
methodology.runner: scripts/isaac_fetch.py; 1200 wall seconds per mission; private domain82; sequential fresh processes; no parameters overridden; Isaac measured profile vs canonical Gazebo profile
methodology.physical_completion_gate: Mission COMPLETE plus recorded attachment, logged lift, >=2 retained palm-relative samples, detach, floor height within existing +/-20mm gate, up-axis z>0.99, final target within 0.50m of home. Offline confirmation only, no robot inputs.
methodology.protocol_gate: Original observer passed and all wrapper exit codes zero; native process crashes also extracted because wrapper exits may hide them.
methodology.grasp_metric: Object-centre base x minus existing red approach_stop_x; y minus zero. Simulator snapshots sampled about every2s and ROS reception times can differ; this is an approximate grasp-entry metric.
methodology.placement_metric: Target XY distance from robot_start/home; aggregate and paired placement deltas only for completed releases.
methodology.evaluator_reuse: ../coco22/measure_fetch.py (unchanged); coco23/analyze.py adds outcome classification, log-derived lift/navigation metrics and aggregates.
methodology.replicates: One trial per seed per backend; no reruns; all attempts retained; no fixes or tuning.
